Εορτάζει στις 7 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. saint.gr keeps the archbishop Alexander of Thessalonica, who sat at the First Ecumenical Council, on 28 Μαΐου, and the corpus holds him as `alexander-of-thessalonica`; this entry is a martyr of that city under Maximian and a separate entry on the same calendar.
